svg.title: Request lifecycle
svg.desc: The browser calls /api same-origin; the host rewrites it to the API; H._handle assigns a request id, answers liveness and readiness first, then routes /api/v1 or /api through the api() dispatcher and the ROUTES table into the bounded context that owns the route; the context reads the read-only, immutable SQLite database; _respond adds caching, an ETag, the security headers, X-Request-Id and X-Service; the access log records the path only. Errors map to 404, 400 or a generic 500.

text.font-family: "Source Serif 4", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What happens to GET /api/ang/712 between the browser and the database — in the order the code does it
